facts.fact: Mr. Allen 同行去旧金山；Clara 对他的感觉是「familiarity」而非火花，像认识了很多年。
facts.anchor: It feels like—familiarity. As though I’ve known him a long time.

facts.fact: Mrs. Guthrie 是 Ben 刚穿越时的收留人，他对她的感情与对 Halloway 完全不同。
facts.anchor: “She had a boarding house in San Francisco,” Ben replies. “She let me stay there and help her until I got on my feet after I arrived.”

facts.fact: 火车与 Peugeot 汽车都颠簸危险；每次车厢震动 Ben 都伸手护住装镜子的木箱。
facts.anchor: every time the train shudders, he reaches out a protective hand to steady it

facts.fact: Mrs. Guthrie 见面就质疑 ward 是不是 mistress（喜剧场面），Ben 以人格担保她只是受助的女孩。
facts.anchor: She had better not be some mistress you’re trying to bring here.

facts.fact: Mrs. Guthrie 提到「wicked Miss Swanson」被 Ben 一个硬眼神止住——第一个未解之谜。
facts.anchor: Of course, you don’t give them a chance since that wicked Miss Swanson⁠—

facts.fact: Mr. Allen 身世：英国旧世家没钱被派美娶富妻；Ben 帮他投资后不再需要。
facts.anchor: “Exactly. Will’s smart, though. I helped him make some investments, and he no longer has need of a rich wife.”

facts.fact: Ben 的金钱观：钱在 1901 用不完也带不回家，托 Will 打理。
facts.anchor: I can’t be certain it will follow me home when that day comes.

facts.fact: Ben 承认与 Miss Swanson「陷得比应该的深，是个大错误」——他对深入过去关系的恐惧来源。
facts.anchor: “I became more involved than I should have, and it was a big mistake.”

facts.fact: Ben 提议：如果回不去，考虑「更永久的关系」作时代掩护；Clara 听成婚姻。
facts.anchor: “We should consider a more permanent relationship … while we’re here.”

facts.fact: 章末 Clara 独自面对「永远回不了家」的恐惧，只能自我打气。
facts.anchor: trying not to let fear about never going home spread through me
